component.name: customItemForSubscriptionListInShowDeatilPage
component.script:
sub Init() m.Poster = m.top.findNode("poster") m.name_label =m.top.findNode("name_label") m.main_rect =m.top.findNode("main_rect") m.subscriptionCornerRounded =m.top.findNode("subscriptionCornerRounded") end sub
sub updateLayout() if m.top.height > 0 And m.top.width > 0 then m.main_rect.width = m.top.width m.main_rect.height = m.top.height m.name_label.height = m.top.height m.name_label.width = m.top.width m.subscriptionCornerRounded.height = m.top.height m.subscriptionCornerRounded.width = m.top.width end if end sub
sub itemContentChanged() ?"sdhkjhfkshdkfhkdfkhkhfkds" ?m.top.itemContent m.name_label.text = m.top.itemContent.subscription_text + " "+ m.top.itemContent.subscription_name m.name_label.visible = "true" m.name_label.font.size = "21" end sub
